featured_reviews.name: Ajinkya Deorukhkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are a Latin Dance enthusiast residing in Mumbai or nearby… you already know RGDC by Elvis and Namrata is THE BEST PLACE to pursue your interests in Salsa, Kizomba, Mambo, Urban Kiz etc. Watching them conduct workshops and perform shows since I began learning Latin Dances more than 8-9 years ago. Recently I got a chance to join their academy …and I can now vouch for it that this is the best place to learn Salsa and Kizomba.
They have learned their Art very well from the best sources and have been practising and updating themselves a lot!.. only to bring each and every student’s best foot forward.

Very structured, organised, professional way of teaching and sharing in-depth knowledge about the music and the dance forms, great instructions. The studios they teach at are amazing, safe space. I highly recommend RGDC Elvis and Namrata to everyone, from Beginners to Advance level students, they have a lot of knowledge! Grab it.

featured_reviews.name: Bineet Kaur
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been learning salsa at RGDC since 2017 and I don’t think I could have found better teachers than Namrata and Elvis to learn this dance form. They have created a safe space for anyone who wishes to learn any Afro Latin style. Apart from being excellent dancers, both Namrata and Elvis are great instructors. Their passion for dance has kept them going for over a decade now. I would highly recommend RGDC to anyone who wishes to learn dance.

featured_reviews.name: anuradha ansari
featured_reviews.review_text: I would highly recommend RGDC to everyone who has a passion for dance. Namrata and Elvis are internationally  trained professional teachers. Learn with the best in a safe space .With an eye on the basics and a flair for styling, this school touches the skies. Doesn’t get better folks !!

featured_reviews.name: Amita Chowdhury
featured_reviews.review_text:
This Dance class is MUST for all Mumbaikar s, people taking halt in this city for couple of months please ensure you enjoy the vibe & fun-filled learning from none other than Elvis & Namrata, the best of the bests time proven.
Elvis & Namrata - have been teaching since a decade now,  have World Semba-Kizomba Championship 🏆 in their wallet .
Elvis on the other hand , is also renowned for World Salsa Championship Professional Solo category Winner 🏆 and World House Championship 🏆 trophy too under his name. And this list goes on and on.

One must come to learn and experience himself what makes an International Champion who he/she is. Word's fall short of how dedicated and disciplined Elvis & Namrata are both in their personal as well as professional life. Precision Teaching, World class techniques, Great Instructions, Personal feedback student wise , focused on students growth -- these are the great qualities one can aim for learning any Dance form. In a nutshell, it's 10 on 10.

featured_reviews.name: sheetal mallar
featured_reviews.review_text: I have had a great time learning Salsa on 1 and 2 and kizomba with Rare grooves dance company. They are excellent teachers. Both of them bring their unique strengths to the table from shines , body movement , partner work.  I have been going to them for 8 years. I highly recommend Elvis and Namratas classes at Rare Grooves.

featured_reviews.name: Jovita Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text: Elvis and Namrata put in a lot of effort to ensure they have a new routine prepared for you every class. They will  not only teach you to understand the dance form but also the musicality and culture behind it. As a student I definitely have seen myself grow and absorb a lot from them.

I still remember the day I went for a trial class, recommended by a friend—never knowing it would become such a big part of my life. I never imagined doing Zumba, but I’m so glad I showed up and stuck around. Looking back, it’s one of the best decisions I’ve ever made!

featured_reviews.review_text:
The last three weeks have been truly amazing! Even in this short span, we’ve seen small but definite progress in Xael. She’s becoming more confident, and most importantly, she absolutely loves the class.

A special thank you to Shruti — her energy, patience, and the way she connects with the kids is truly wonderful. Xael speaks so fondly of her, and we can clearly see that she feels encouraged and excited to learn every time.

featured_reviews.name: R S
featured_reviews.review_text:
I started learning Kathak with DanceKatha in October 2024, and it has been one of the best decisions I’ve made for myself.

Learning Indian classical dance was always my dream, and at the age of 45, I finally chose myself and began this journey.

The learning experience has been smooth, enjoyable, and deeply fulfilling. My teacher, Mitika, is amazing ......extremely patient, supportive, and very clear in her teaching. She makes the classes feel comfortable and encouraging, even for beginners that too who dont have any knowledge of classical dances.
And the founder-  Riddhi’s unmatched energy and passion are the heartbeat of DanceKatha.

DanceKatha is a wonderful platform for both adults and children to learn classical dance online from anywhere in the world. I would highly recommend it to anyone who wants to reconnect with Indian classical arts as it’s  never too late to start.

featured_reviews.name: Poonam Panda
featured_reviews.review_text: My 6 year old daughter has been learning Kathak at DanceKatha for the last 18 months and I have witnessed the steep progression my daughter has gone through in this time with her Kathak dancing skills. She has become very poised and confident in her dancing and looks forward to learning more and more from her Riddhi teacher. Riddhi is a fantastic teacher and very structured and disciplined in her approach. The kids are pushed to absolutely do their best and dont take these classes lightly. There is attention on each and every child and focus on getting them better every single time. I highly recommend Dancekatha to everyone kids and grown ups who want to pursue their interest in Kathak. You will be learning from the best !!!

featured_reviews.name: Sushma S
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ridhi and her team is doing excellent job. My daughter who is 7yrs old learning kathak from Dancekatha under the guidance of Guru Olivia. Can't believe the level of understanding and the way she is copping up. Hats off to the teacher patience.. and my daughter learns this class with lot of interest (which is very very important, coz we cannot force them) and will be waiting for it.. For a wonder this is virtual class!
Thanks again

featured_reviews.name: Avantika Prabhu
featured_reviews.review_text: My name is Avantika Prabhu, and I have been learning from DanceKatha since July 2021. These past few years learning under the guidance of Riddhi Mapxencar, and tutors, Shreya Vidyarthi & Olivia Biswas, have been absolutely amazing. Their patience, determination and dedication towards their students is commendable! From the basic mudras to the most intricate ones, they have assured that it is understood by all! DanceKatha has most definitely made me fall in love with Kathak, and a huge congratulations to Riddhi ma’am for the success of Jhankar 2024. The event was terrific and motivated us students to perform on stage for a live audience, making it a memorable experience for us all. So I would definitely and strongly recommend DanceKatha! 🫶🏼

featured_reviews.name: Sretas Passion
featured_reviews.review_text: Dance Katha taught my 5 year old daughter to be more disciplined and the teachings have really helped her enhance her dancing skills to the next level. It has been a pleasure to be associated with Dance Katha and Riddhi Mapxencar Ma'am who polished my daughter's dancing skills at such an early age. Kathak is such a beautiful dance form which has enhanced her postures and focus too. I would definitely suggest Dance Katha to all through my own personal experience. Keep up the good work 👏 entire Dance Katha Team.

featured_reviews.name: Lalita Drolia
featured_reviews.review_text: DanceKatha is passionate about teaching young children kathak the right away. The teachers focus on every detail and aim for perfection while keeping the lessons fun. The dances being taught are beautiful and help the kids connect with their culture. Our little girl has learnt so much in such little time, we are extremely pleased and can see this turning into a long term association. I would recommend this dance school to all kids looking to learn kathak from the comfort of their homes.

featured_reviews.name: tulika pal
featured_reviews.review_text: Hi, My daughter Mishkaa she started her kathak class from DanceKatha.
